Comfort zone: temperature against humidity

Source: R/fct_plots.R
plot_comfort.Rd

A point for every hour, at its average temperature and humidity, colored by the hour of the day (night blue, morning orange, midday yellow, evening red), over a shaded box for the comfortable ranges. The title says how many of the hours were inside the box, and the corners name what lies that way: warm and dry, warm and humid, cool and dry, cool and humid.

Usage

plot_comfort(
  temperature,
  humidity,
  mode = "light",
  temperature_range = c(20, 25),
  humidity_range = c(40, 60)
)

Arguments

temperature, humidity

Data frames from get_hourly() of temperature and humidity.

mode

"light" or "dark", the mode of the app.

temperature_range, humidity_range

The comfortable ranges, the same as the green bands of the Current tab: 20 to 25 degrees Celsius and 40 to 60%.

Value

A plotly object.

Examples

hours <- expand.grid(hour = 0:23, date = as.Date("2026-10-01") + 0:6)
temperature <- transform(hours, value = 22 + 4 * sin((hour - 9) / 24 * 2 * pi))
humidity <- transform(hours, value = 45 - 8 * sin((hour - 9) / 24 * 2 * pi))
plot_comfort(temperature, humidity)


plot_comfort(temperature, humidity, mode = "dark")
